The '''Kamasto system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamasto]].<ref name="Atlas Extra" />
